items.name: Inn-Luck Harp Charm
items.lore: A tiny harp of bog-oak. The luck of a house sixty years old is in it.

items.name: Ale-Belly Girdle
items.lore: The cluricaun king's belt. Let out several times.

items.name: Luch-Rider Bracer
items.lore: Cluricauns ride the giant luch like ponies. This is from a saddle.

items.name: Cellar-Key Ring
items.lore: The key to Tadhg's cellar, made into a ring. It opens other cellars too, you suspect.

items.name: Amadan's Straw Crown
items.lore: A crown of straw that the amadan wore. Whoever wears it hears music nobody else can.

items.name: Verse-Book Clasp
items.lore: From Eoin's book of poems. Every page is full, and none of it makes sense, and all of it is beautiful.

items.name: Gurite Waylayer Ring
items.lore: Taken off a gurite who robbed travellers on the south road.

items.name: Alp-Luachra Hide Cloak
items.lore: The alp luachra are newts that crawl into sleepers' mouths. The hide is very good leather.
